title: How much of the world's seafood is farmed?
subtitle: Draw how fish farming grew after 1990 beside the wild catch, then see why it took over: the sea's catch hit a ceiling decades ago.
form: ask on a line chart (draw the farmed line on from 1990, beside the wild catch)
notes: Chart in million tonnes (OWID: FAO via World Bank; aquaculture includes molluscs, crustaceans and aquatic plants): farmed 17 Mt (1990) → 141 Mt (2024), passing the wild catch (~90–96 Mt since the mid-1990s) in 2013; farmed share 60% counting seaweed. Animals-only figure from FAO SOFIA 2024 (51% in 2022), said as 'passed the half-way mark in 2022'. The farmed line is staged (1960–1990 drawn before the ask). Review fix round: tonnes view instead of % chart, seaweed said up front, 'servings' dropped.
